test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 17 Oct, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined word in the given sentence.

Reduced price of cooking gas brought __happy__ to the face of every citizen.
solution:
The correct answer is '4' i.e. happiness .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence needs a noun to describe the emotion brought to the faces of the citizens by the reduced price of cooking gas.
 
• The word "happiness" is a noun and correctly fits in the sentence as it describes the state of being happy.
 
• Other options such as "happier" and "happiest" are comparative and superlative adjectives respectively, and "happily" is an adverb, which do not fit the context of the sentence.

Correct sentence: *Reduced price of cooking gas brought **happiness** to the face of every citizen*.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Comparative Adjectives:**

 
 
• **Usage:** Used to compare differences between two objects.
 
• **Example:** She is happier than her sister.
 
 
 
• **Superlative Adjectives:**
 
 
• **Usage: **Used to describe an object which is at the upper or lower limit of a quality.
 
• **Example: **She is the happiest person in the room.
